string.name: name
string.value: Focused Fury

string.name: desc
string.value: Constant attacks focus your concentration, increasing your Abnormal Status Resistance. Resisting an Abnormal Status while this buff is in effect will trigger a cooldown on the skill. Also increases Abnormal Status Resistance and All Elemental Resistances permanently.

string.name: h
string.value: While attacking Abnormal Status Resistance will increase by #x% for #time sec regularly. When an Abnormal Status is resisted, Cooldown: #cooltime sec. \n[Passive Effects: Abnormal Status Resistance and all Elemental Resistances increase by #asrR%]

string.name: desc
string.value: Ignore a portion of the enemy's Defense. Permanently increases your Accuracy and total Damage.

string.name: h
string.value: When attacking, ignores #ignoreMobpdpR% of monster's Weapon Defense. Increases Accuracy by #ar% and total Damage by #damR%

string.name: desc
string.value: Temporarily summons Freezer to deal Ice damage to up to 4 enemies. In addition, permanently increases Weapon/Magic Defense.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, summon Freezer for #time sec. Attacks up to 4 enemies at once with #damage% damage. Freezes for #x sec\n[Passive Effects: Increases Weapon/Magic Defense by #pddR%]

string.name: name
string.value: Dragon's Breath

string.name: desc
string.value: Draws upon the spirit of the dragon to fire an arrow of tremendous force that pushes enemies away. Its effect increases with each enemy it pierces.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%

string.name: name
string.value: Explosive Bolt

string.name: desc
string.value: Fires an arrow that sends multiple bolts in all directions on impact. The enemy struck by the initial arrow takes additional damage.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, attack up to #mobCount enemies with #damage% damage. #x% additional damage to the first target enemy

string.name: desc
string.value: Fires a hook at the furthest enemy within range, dealing damage and pulling yourself along. While moving, you won't collide with monsters. Also increases your HP.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, after attacking with #damage% damage, moves by passing through enemies\n[Passive Effects: Max HP increases by #mhpR%]

string.name: name
string.value: Pain Killer

string.name: desc
string.value: Consumes a prepared Herb to remove Abnormal Status immediately. Additionally, increases all Elemental Resistances and Abnormal Status Resistances permanently.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, Clear Status and make you immune to it for #time sec. Cooldown: #cooltime sec.\n[Passive Effect : Increase Abnormal Status Resistance and all Elemental Resistance by #asrR%]
